name: Turn off activity history
description: Stops Windows from recording and uploading user activity history while keeping the activity feed active for clipboard history.

name: Turn off hibernation
description: Disables system hibernation, deletes the hiberfil.sys file to free disk space, and hides the hibernate power menu option.

name: Remove Widgets
description: Stops Widget processes, uninstalls the Widgets runtime and Windows Web Experience packages, and restarts File Explorer.

name: Restore the previous Start menu layout
description: Sets a feature override key to use the earlier Start menu layout. Does not work when update KB5089573 or a newer build is installed.
notice: Has no effect on builds that include KB5089573 or later.

name: Block Microsoft Store suggestions in Start search
description: Denies access to the local store.db file so Start menu searches stop showing suggested Microsoft Store applications.

name: Turn off location tracking
description: Denies location access, turns off sensor permissions and automatic map updates, and disables the Geolocation service.

name: Set services to manual start
description: Sets MapsBroker and StorSvc to manual start and disables the CscService, DiagTrack, and SharedAccess services.

name: Turn off svchost.exe process splitting
description: Sets the service host split threshold to total installed memory so Windows groups services into fewer svchost.exe processes after a restart.
notice: Restart Windows after changing this setting.

name: Turn off Brave browser add-ons and reporting
description: Applies group policies to disable Brave Rewards, Wallet, VPN, AI chat, News, Talk, Tor, and usage reporting in Brave.

name: Suppress warnings for unsigned RDP files
description: Sets Terminal Services client registry values to skip security prompts when opening unsigned Remote Desktop connection files.

name: Turn off Microsoft Edge promotions and diagnostic data
description: Applies group policies in Microsoft Edge to disable diagnostic data, rewards, shopping tools, collections, web widgets, and first-run prompts.

name: Stop automatic installs of promoted apps
description: Sets the CloudContent policy that stops Windows from installing promoted Microsoft Store apps on its own.

name: Turn off Windows telemetry
description: Disables diagnostic data collection, advertising ID, input personalization, feedback prompts, PowerShell telemetry, and the DiagTrack and WerSvc services.

name: Turn off Delivery Optimization peer sharing
description: Sets DODownloadMode to 0 so Windows downloads updates only from Microsoft servers without sharing pieces with other PCs.

name: Remove Microsoft Edge
description: Creates a placeholder file in the old Edge directory and runs the Microsoft Edge installer to remove the browser system-wide.

name: Turn off BitLocker
description: Starts decrypting the system drive in the background. The drive stays usable while it decrypts.
notice: Decryption runs in the background. Re-enable from Settings, Privacy & security, Device encryption.

name: Use UTC for the hardware clock
description: Sets RealTimeIsUniversal to 1 so Windows treats the motherboard clock as Coordinated Universal Time when dual-booting.

name: Remove OneDrive
description: Disables OneSyncSvc, runs the OneDrive uninstaller while guarding user files with a temporary ACL rule, and restarts File Explorer.

name: Hide Home and Gallery in File Explorer
description: Unpins the Home and Gallery items from the File Explorer navigation pane and sets This PC as the starting view.

name: Set visual effects for performance
description: Turns off window animations, Aero Peek, taskbar animations, full-window dragging, and list-view shadows, and shortens menu and keyboard delays.

name: Turn off reserved storage
description: Disables the disk space Windows reserves for updates and temporary system files through DISM.

name: Create a restore point
description: Removes the waiting period between restore points, enables System Restore on the system drive, and records a new restore point.

name: Show End task in the taskbar menu
description: Adds the End task command to the context menu when right-clicking an application on the taskbar.

name: Turn off Storage Sense
description: Disables automatic disk cleanup by Storage Sense in the current user profile.

name: Remove Windows AI components
description: Hides the AI components settings page, disables Notepad AI, stops WSAIFabricSvc, removes Copilot and CoreAI packages, and disables Recall.

name: Turn off Windows Platform Binary Table execution
description: Sets DisableWpbtExecution to 1 so Windows does not run firmware-embedded programs from the ACPI WPBT table during startup.

name: Block device metadata downloads
description: Sets PreventDeviceMetadataFromNetwork to 1 so Windows does not fetch metadata or companion software when hardware is connected.

name: Block automatic Razer software installation
description: Turns off automatic driver searching and device co-installers, empties the Windows Installer Razer folder, and denies write access to it.

name: Block Logitech Download Assistant
description: Stops the logi_download_assistant process, empties the Program Files LogiDownloadAssistant folder, and denies write permissions to it.

name: Turn off Notification Center and toast popups
description: Disables the taskbar Notification Center, calendar flyout, and desktop toast notifications for the current user.

name: Block Adobe activation and tracking hosts
description: Writes a pinned list of Adobe domains to the system hosts file and flushes the DNS resolver cache.

name: Restore the classic right-click menu
description: Registers an empty in-process server for the Windows 11 context menu handler and restarts File Explorer to show the full menu.

name: Run Disk Cleanup and component store reset
description: Runs cleanmgr on the system drive and uses DISM to remove superseded component versions from the WinSxS store.

name: Delete temporary files
description: Removes unlocked files and folders from the user %TEMP% directory and %SystemRoot%\Temp.

name: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
description: Sets DisabledComponents to 32 in Tcpip6 parameters so Windows chooses IPv4 connections before IPv6.

name: Turn off Teredo tunneling
description: Sets DisabledComponents to 1 and disables the Teredo IPv6 transition interface through netsh.

name: Turn off IPv6
description: Sets DisabledComponents to 255 and unbinds the TCP/IPv6 protocol from network adapters.
notice: Restart Windows after changing this setting.

name: Stop packaged apps from running in the background
description: Sets GlobalUserDisabled to 1 so Microsoft Store apps do not run background tasks for the current user.

name: Turn off folder type discovery in File Explorer
description: Clears saved folder view caches and sets the default folder template to general items so File Explorer stops scanning contents.
notice: Sign out or restart for the change to take effect. Saved folder views are deleted, and undo does not bring them back.

name: Detailed stop error screen
description: Shows the stop code parameters on the crash screen and leaves out the sad face.

name: Battery percentage on the taskbar
description: Displays the remaining battery charge as a number next to the battery icon in the system tray.

name: Dark theme
description: Uses dark colors for the Windows shell and supported desktop applications.

name: File name extensions in File Explorer
description: Displays file type suffixes like .exe and .txt on all files in File Explorer.

name: Hidden files and folders in File Explorer
description: Displays files and directories marked with the hidden attribute in File Explorer.

name: Detailed startup and shutdown status messages
description: Shows step-by-step service and policy status messages during sign-in, sign-out, startup, and shutdown.

name: New Outlook for Windows
description: Selects the new Outlook app in Office 16 preferences and shows the switch toggle inside classic Outlook.

name: Always show scrollbars
description: Keeps scrollbars at full width instead of shrinking them when the pointer moves away.

name: Multiplane overlay
description: Controls Desktop Window Manager hardware overlay planes through OverlayTestMode and DisableOverlays.

options.label: Disabled (Compatibility)
options.description: Disables MPO using OverlayTestMode=5, the less aggressive compatibility method.

options.label: Fully Disabled
options.description: Disables MPO using OverlayTestMode=5 and DisableOverlays=1, the more aggressive method.

name: Mouse acceleration
description: Scales pointer movement distance with physical mouse speed through the MouseSpeed, MouseThreshold1, and MouseThreshold2 registry values.

name: Num Lock at startup
description: Turns on the numeric keypad Num Lock state on the sign-in screen and after signing in.

name: Window snapping
description: Resizes and tiles windows automatically when dragged to the edges or corners of the screen.

name: Network connectivity during Modern Standby
description: Keeps network adapters connected on AC power while the system is in S0 low-power idle.

name: Traditional S3 sleep mode
description: Sets PlatformAoAcOverride to 0 to disable S0 Modern Standby and request traditional S3 suspend-to-RAM.

name: Home page in Settings
description: Controls whether the Home landing page appears in the Windows Settings app.

name: Bing web results in Start menu search
description: Includes web results from Microsoft Bing when searching from the taskbar or Start menu.

name: Sign-in screen background blur
description: Applies the acrylic blur effect to the background image on the Windows sign-in screen.

name: Skip the lock screen
description: Sets NoLockScreen to 1, so Windows goes straight to the sign-in prompt at startup and on wake.

name: Recommended section in the Start menu
description: Shows or hides the Recommended section in the Start menu and restarts File Explorer. Turning it off also disables lock screen Windows Spotlight.

name: Sticky Keys shortcut
description: Controls the Sticky Keys accessibility prompt triggered by pressing the Shift key five times.

name: Centered taskbar icons
description: Centers taskbar icons when turned on or moves them to the left edge when turned off.

name: Search button on the taskbar
description: Shows or hides the search icon on the taskbar.

name: Task View button on the taskbar
description: Shows or hides the virtual desktop Task View button on the taskbar.

name: Game Mode
description: Turns automatic Game Mode on or off in the GameBar registry settings.

name: Win32 file paths over 260 characters
description: Sets LongPathsEnabled to 1 in the file system configuration to remove the 260-character MAX_PATH limit.

name: Run O&O ShutUp10++
description: Downloads OOSU10.exe from oo-software.com into %LocalAppData%\WindowCraft, checks its Authenticode signature, and starts it.

name: DNS server
description: Configures IPv4, IPv6, and DNS-over-HTTPS resolvers on active network adapters or returns them to DHCP.

name: Add the Ultimate Performance power plan
description: Duplicates the Ultimate Performance power scheme template and sets it as the active power plan.

name: Remove the Ultimate Performance power plan
description: Switches to the Balanced power scheme if needed and deletes every Ultimate Performance power plan copy.
